corbis.name: corbis
corbis.description: Use the Corbis MCP server for domain-specialized literature search over a curated finance/economics corpus. Hybrid semantic + keyword search, per-journal top-cited papers, batch full-text fetch, BibTeX export. OAuth through the MCP client is the supported auth path. Always reads process_log/corbis_status.json first, resolves capability-to-tool names, and falls back to OpenAlex (breadth) and WebSearch (grey lit) when Corbis returns nothing relevant or is unavailable.
